definitions.explanation: A word or phrase preceded by the hash symbol (#), used on social media to identify posts on a specific topic and make them searchable.

examples.japanese: ハッシュタグを{付|つ}けて{投稿|とうこう}する。
この{写真|しゃしん}にはハッシュタグが{多|おお}すぎる。
examples.english: This photo has too many hashtags.

examples.japanese: {人気|にんき}のハッシュタグを{検索|けんさく}する。

notes:
USAGE: ハッシュタグ is commonly used on platforms like Twitter/X, Instagram, and TikTok to categorize and discover content.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
・ハッシュタグを{付|つ}ける (to add a hashtag)
・ハッシュタグを{付|つ}けて{投稿|とうこう}する (to post with a hashtag)
・ハッシュタグで{検索|けんさく}する (to search by hashtag)
・{人気|にんき}のハッシュタグ (popular hashtag)
・{関連|かんれん}ハッシュタグ (related hashtag)

ABBREVIATION: Often shortened to タグ in casual conversation.

RELATED TERMS:
・{#|シャープ}/{#|ハッシュ} (the # symbol)
・タグ{付|づ}け (tagging)
・トレンド (trending topics)
